verses.en: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.pt: Toda mulher sábia edifica a sua casa; a insensata, porém, derruba-a com as suas mãos.
verses.en_web: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
verses.en_bbe: Wisdom is building her house, but the foolish woman is pulling it down with her hands.

verses.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.pt: Quem anda na sua retidão teme ao Senhor; mas aquele que é perverso nos seus caminhos despreza-o.
verses.en_web: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
verses.en_bbe: He who goes on his way in righteousness has before him the fear of the Lord; but he whose ways are twisted gives him no honour.

verses.en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.pt: Na boca do tolo está a vara da soberba, mas os lábios do sábio preservá-lo-ão.
verses.en_web: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
verses.en_bbe: In the mouth of the foolish man is a rod for his back, but the lips of the wise will keep them safe.

verses.en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.pt: Onde não há bois, a manjedoura está vazia; mas pela força do boi há abundância de colheitas.
verses.en_web: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.en_bbe: Where there are no oxen, their food-place is clean; but much increase comes through the strength of the ox.

verses.en: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.pt: A testemunha verdadeira não mentirá; a testemunha falsa, porém, se desboca em mentiras.
verses.en_web: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
verses.en_bbe: A true witness does not say what is false, but a false witness is breathing out deceit.

verses.en: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.pt: O escarnecedor busca sabedoria, e não a encontra; mas para o prudente o conhecimento é fácil.
verses.en_web: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
verses.en_bbe: The hater of authority, searching for wisdom, does not get it; but knowledge comes readily to the open-minded man.

verses.en: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.pt: Vai-te da presença do homem insensato, pois nele não acharás palavras de ciência.
verses.en_web: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
verses.en_bbe: Go away from the foolish man, for you will not see the lips of knowledge.

verses.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.pt: A sabedoria do prudente é entender o seu caminho; porém a estultícia dos tolos é enganar.
verses.en_web: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.en_bbe: The wisdom of the man of good sense makes his way clear; but the unwise behaviour of the foolish is deceit.

verses.en: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
verses.pt: A culpa zomba dos insensatos; mas os retos têm o favor de Deus.
verses.en_web: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
verses.en_bbe: In the tents of those hating authority there is error, but in the house of the upright man there is grace.

verses.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.pt: O coração conhece a sua própria amargura; e o estranho não participa da sua alegria.
verses.en_web: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
verses.en_bbe: No one has knowledge of a man's grief but himself; and a strange person has no part in his joy.

verses.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.pt: A casa dos ímpios se desfará; porém a tenda dos retos florescerá.
verses.en_web: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.en_bbe: The house of the sinner will be overturned, but the tent of the upright man will do well.

verses.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.pt: Há um caminho que ao homem parece direito, mas o fim dele conduz à morte.
verses.en_web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.en_bbe: There is a way which seems straight before a man, but its end is the ways of death.

verses.en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
verses.pt: Até no riso terá dor o coração; e o fim da alegria é tristeza.
verses.en_web: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
verses.en_bbe: Even while laughing the heart may be sad; and after joy comes sorrow.

verses.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.pt: Dos seus próprios caminhos se fartará o infiel de coração, como também o homem bom se contentará dos seus.
verses.en_web: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
verses.en_bbe: He whose heart is turned away will have the reward of his ways in full measure; but a good man will have the reward of his doings.

verses.en: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.pt: O simples dá crédito a tudo; mas o prudente atenta para os seus passos.
verses.en_web: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
verses.en_bbe: The simple man has faith in every word, but the man of good sense gives thought to his footsteps.

verses.en: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.pt: O sábio teme e desvia-se do mal, mas o tolo é arrogante e dá-se por seguro.
verses.en_web: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
verses.en_bbe: The wise man, fearing, keeps himself from evil; but the foolish man goes on in his pride, with no thought of danger.

verses.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.pt: Quem facilmente se ira fará doidices; mas o homem discreto é paciente;
verses.en_web: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
verses.en_bbe: He who is quickly angry will do what is foolish, but the man of good sense will have quiet.

verses.en: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.pt: Os simples herdam a estultícia; mas os prudentes se coroam de conhecimento.
verses.en_web: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: Foolish behaviour is the heritage of the simple, but men of good sense are crowned with knowledge.

verses.en: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.pt: Os maus inclinam-se perante os bons; e os ímpios diante das portas dos justos.
verses.en_web: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: The knees of the evil are bent before the good; and sinners go down in the dust at the doors of the upright.

verses.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
verses.pt: O pobre é odiado até pelo seu vizinho; mas os amigos dos ricos são muitos.
verses.en_web: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
verses.en_bbe: The poor man is hated even by his neighbour, but the man of wealth has numbers of friends.

verses.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.pt: O que despreza ao seu vizinho peca; mas feliz é aquele que se compadece dos pobres.
verses.en_web: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who has pity on the poor.
verses.en_bbe: He who has no respect for his neighbour is a sinner, but he who has pity for the poor is happy.

verses.en: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.pt: Porventura não erram os que maquinam o mal? mas há beneficência e fidelidade para os que planejam o bem.
verses.en_web: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
verses.en_bbe: Will not the designers of evil come into error? But mercy and good faith are for the designers of good.

verses.en: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.pt: Em todo trabalho há proveito; meras palavras, porém, só encaminham para a penúria.
verses.en_web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
verses.en_bbe: In all hard work there is profit, but talk only makes a man poor.

verses.en: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.pt: A coroa dos sábios é a sua riqueza; porém a estultícia dos tolos não passa de estultícia.
verses.en_web: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
verses.en_bbe: Their wisdom is a crown to the wise, but their foolish behaviour is round the head of the unwise.

verses.en: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
verses.pt: A testemunha verdadeira livra as almas; mas o que fala mentiras é traidor.
verses.en_web: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
verses.en_bbe: A true witness is the saviour of lives; but he who says false things is a cause of deceit.

verses.en: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.pt: No temor do Senhor há firme confiança; e os seus filhos terão um lugar de refúgio.
verses.en_web: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
verses.en_bbe: For him in whose heart is the fear of the Lord there is strong hope: and his children will have a safe place.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.pt: O temor do Senhor é uma fonte de vida, para o homem se desviar dos laços da morte.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, by which one may be turned from the nets of death.

verses.en: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.pt: Na multidão do povo está a glória do rei; mas na falta de povo está a ruína do príncipe.
verses.en_web: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.en_bbe: A king's glory is in the number of his people: and for need of people a ruler may come to destruction.

verses.en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.pt: Quem é tardio em irar-se é grande em entendimento; mas o que é de ânimo precipitado exalta a loucura.
verses.en_web: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
verses.en_bbe: He who is slow to be angry has great good sense; but he whose spirit is over-quick gives support to what is foolish.

verses.en: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.pt: O coração tranqüilo é a vida da carne; a inveja, porém, é a podridão dos ossos.
verses.en_web: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
verses.en_bbe: A quiet mind is the life of the body, but envy is a disease in the bones.

verses.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.pt: O que oprime ao pobre insulta ao seu Criador; mas honra-o aquele que se compadece do necessitado.
verses.en_web: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
verses.en_bbe: He who is hard on the poor puts shame on his Maker; but he who has mercy on those who are in need gives him honour.

verses.en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.pt: O ímpio é derrubado pela sua malícia; mas o justo até na sua morte acha refúgio.
verses.en_web: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
verses.en_bbe: The sinner is overturned in his evil-doing, but the upright man has hope in his righteousness.

verses.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.pt: No coração do prudente repousa a sabedoria; mas no coração dos tolos não é conhecida.
verses.en_web: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
verses.en_bbe: Wisdom has her resting-place in the mind of the wise, but she is not seen among the foolish.

verses.en: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.pt: A justiça exalta as nações; mas o pecado é o opróbrio dos povos.
verses.en_web: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
verses.en_bbe: By righteousness a nation is lifted up, but sin is a cause of shame to the peoples.

verses.en: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
verses.pt: O favor do rei é concedido ao servo que procede sabiamente; mas sobre o que procede indignamente cairá o seu furor.
verses.en_web: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
verses.en_bbe: The king has pleasure in a servant who does wisely, but his wrath is against him who is a cause of shame.
